description: The Mcp-Name routing header names a read-only tool while the JSON-RPC body calls a money-moving tool. A gateway that authorizes on the mirrored header and forwards the body lets the wrong call through. The spec makes the body the source of truth and requires rejection with -32020.

expected.signal: Mcp-Name header value does not match params.name in the body; reject 400 with JSON-RPC error -32020 (HeaderMismatch)
expected.rationale: streamable-http §Server Validation: servers MUST reject requests where header values do not match the body, precisely to stop a load balancer routing on the header while the server executes the body.

provenance: synthetic — derived from the normative rule and error code in modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/basic/transports/streamable-http §Server Validation
